component.name: ASGARDEX
component.summary: Cross-chain DeFi wallet for THORChain, MAYAChain, and more

description.p: ASGARDEX is a non-custodial desktop wallet and exchange client for THORChain, MAYAChain, Chainflip, and other supported networks. Swap assets across chains, manage liquidity, and hold funds with keystore, Ledger, or Vultisig vaults.
Ledger hardware wallets: on Linux, install the Ledger udev rules on the host once so the device is visible to the app (including Flatpak). See the project README for the rule package and setup steps.

screenshot.caption: Pools overview with swap and add-liquidity actions

description.p: OneClick fee accuracy, Midgard-resilient quotes, and safer Chainflip/THOR deposit flows.

ul.li: Swap: show the OneClick affiliate from the aggregator's echoed appFees (no more false "free"); swap details tuned per protocol for Chainflip and OneClick; outbound fee uses the quote's destination asset and USD value; swap routes no longer all freeze when THOR Midgard is down.
Swap: stop lastblock polls from re-firing quotes every 60 seconds.
Chainflip submit UX (channel-open in the transaction modal), asset search ranks native ETH first, smarter halt banners, and quotes pause while you confirm.
THORChain/MAYAChain: never auto-retry keystore MsgDeposit broadcasts.
Swap: restore the ERC20 Approve button when a quote is blocked by approval.
EVM: EIP-1559 tip and base-fee headroom for THOR/MAYA pool deposit transactions.
Swap: skip quote requests for trading-halted THOR/MAYA routes.

description.p: Fixes Solana broadcast fees, reduces THORChain API load, and advances Flatpak packaging toward Flathub.

ul.li: Solana: floor the priority fee so OneClick token swaps can broadcast.
THORChain: cut load from swap tx/stages polling (block-time floor, no pending double-fire, incomplete max-age).
Flatpak: rename the app id to com.asgardex.Asgardex, harden host keystore/Vultisig migration, and pin the Windows NSIS guid.

description.p: The Kujira client is no longer supported. New feature: keystore HD recovery with Find my funds (EVM, THOR/MAYA, UTXO), using a simple scan or custom paths.

ul.li: Keystore: HD "Find my funds" for EVM, THOR/MAYA, and UTXO chains.
EVM: re-clamp a native Max send at broadcast so fee re-quotes cannot overshoot the balance (Max no longer fails with dust insufficient-funds).
Source UTXO inbound fee rates from the node gas_rate.
Swap: show the routing protocol in the chart panel and track OneClick (NEAR Intents) swaps.
Remove the native Kujira (KUJI) chain client, which is no longer listed on THOR/MAYA pools.
